question: In a certain code language, ‘COMPUTER’ is written as ‘DQNRVVFT’ and 'GARDENER' is written as 'HCSFFPFT'. How will ‘ACADEMIC’ be written as in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

‘COMPUTER’ is written as ‘DQNRVVFT’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0f467d32777e4a03b1da1c068f3447473dfc33605cd02ff75771fc5fc89dfdf1.png] 

And,

'GARDENER' is written as 'HCSFFPFT'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b601fa493abd360571b4acadbd0d72f56cf3f4a475ee60c55639289537c4e49d.png] 

Similarly,

‘ACADEMIC’ is written as

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/428097270e3b7a41cf212b3a1cd1ffc2242ed93623f41aaa4eff5c6e9921b8a7.png] 

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
